Hornets 124Cavaliers 112

Allen and Reid end Charlotte's skid

Final · Mon, Nov 9 · Charlotte

Charlotte beat Cleveland 124–112, a 12-point home win. The Hornets move to 4–7; the Cavaliers fall to 5–6.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · How it went

Won the second quarter 40–25

Up 1 after one quarter, the Hornets won the second quarter 40–25 to lead 69–53.

2 of 5 · Who carried it

Allen: 27 points, six threes

6 of 12 from three, 8 of 14 overall, 6 assists.

3 of 5 · The Cavaliers’ side

From the Cavaliers’ side.

Lost the second quarter 25–40, the stretch that decided it.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it from three and on the glass

Threes made 23–14; rebounds 49–32. Charlotte made 23 of 46 threes.

5 of 5 · What it meant

Hornets 124, Cavaliers 112.

The Hornets move to 4–8, 10th in the East. The Cavaliers fall to 6–6, 6th in the East.
